name: qualify-async-few-py
note: Expected: good, good-wait, and good-gather pass; sequential and noop (the fixture's page, one lookup after another) fail within_budget only; wait-all (gather with return_exceptions=True, so a 503 waits for a slow catalog) fails within_budget only; leaky-gather (gather without cancellation) fails no_leaked_work only; racy (stock and reviews left to background tasks that fill the page in after it was returned, catalog and pricing awaited with return_exceptions=True) fails all four required checks; wrong (a TaskGroup whose ExceptionGroup is not unwrapped) fails failures_as_specified only (fixture_tests fails too, a measure); overall-deadline (a 380 ms deadline on the whole page) fails failures_as_specified only. Command arms need no toolchain: the check runs everything. Needs bubblewrap and python3 3.11 or later at /usr/bin.
